Type: distressed medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or bedroom area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, traditional, contemporary
Materials: low pile, faded vintage-look weave
Colors: dark navy, slate blue, yellow, pink, green accents
Shape: rectangular, central floral medallion on worn navy field, ornate floral borders, flat profile, large
Feel: moody, rich, vintage, eclectic
Goes with: dark wood floors, beige or grey upholstery, brass accents; bohemian or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Passionate Area Rug, 6' 7" x 9' 6", Navy
product.description: Add elegance to your home decor with this lovely rug. With a blue-focused color scheme and a distinct flourish pattern, this rug is a perfect match for traditional-style interior design. Its captivating design also pairs well with modern and vintage home-decor styles. 6'7" x 9'6" Pile: 100% polypropylene; backing: 100% jute Advanced power-loom construction for excellent value and quality Medium 0.5'' pile ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms
